descriptionChirho: Clearly visible, openly known, or plainly evident to perception or understanding; used predicatively or attributively of things, deeds, or persons that are apparent (Mt 12:16; Mk 3:12; 4:22; 6:14; Lk 8:17; Acts 4:16; 7:13; Rom 1:19; 1 Cor 3:13; 11:19; 14:25; Gal 5:19; Phil 1:13; 1 Tim 4:15; 1 Jn 3:10).
Pertaining to what is visible or external in contrast to what is inward or hidden, used in the distinction between outward and inward identity (Rom 2:28).
